antenna_ports.description: Antenna-port outputs (the RF field at an antenna, before any receiver).

epoch.description: UTC instant of truth time zero.

library.description: Where library items are looked up.

platforms.description: Platforms: anything with a position that carries emitters or receivers.

render.description: Render settings for `sim run` (duration and block length).

resources.description: Shared hardware resources (NIC, disk, USB, PCIe) that sinks use.

schema_version.description: Scenario format version. This build reads version 1.

seed.description: Seed for every random stream (0 to 2⁶³−1, the TOML integer range).

sinks.description: Output sinks that channels and antenna ports stream to.

world.description:
Earth model: geoid grid and local atmosphere (MSL heights, flight levels and
Mode C altitude).

enabled.description: Quantize and clip (default true). Off, the channel writes unquantized cf32.

full_scale.description:
Full scale: the power of a CW tone whose components just reach the clip level
(default 0 dBm).

AgcSpec.description: Automatic gain control (receiver chain stage 6, off unless given).

target.description: Target RMS level relative to the ADC full scale (default −12 dB).

Altitude.description: A altitude with a unit (m, km, ft, nmi, FL), written as a string, e.g. "35000 ft MSL". Units are case-sensitive.

Angle.description: A angle with a unit (deg, °, rad, DMS (12°34'56.7" or 12d34m56.7s)), written as a string, e.g. "12.5 deg". Units are case-sensitive.

AntennaPort.description:
An antenna-port output: the field at an antenna, band-limited by B_out, with
no virtual-receiver effects (contracts §5).

bandwidth.description: Bandwidth of the output response B_out (below its stopband).

full_scale.description: Output full scale: the power of a CW tone at sc16 code 32768 (default 0 dBm).

mount.description: The mount the antenna sits on (default: the platform origin).

Channel.description: One tuned channel of a virtual receiver.

adc.description: The virtual ADC (defaults when absent: 0 dBm full scale, 16 bits, on).

bandwidth.description: Passband width of the receiver response H_rx (below its stopband).

front_end.description: Front-end gain and noise figure (off when absent: 0 dB gain, 0 dB noise figure).

iq.description: IQ imbalance and DC offset (off when absent).

oneOf.description: Samples exactly at the nominal instants (`IdealClockMap`).
Nominal instants shifted by a constant `offset` (an ideal map with a later epoch).

offset.description:
Sampling-instant offset for `fixed_offset`: every sample is acquired this much
later than nominal.

DataRate.description: A data rate with a unit (b/s, kb/s, Mb/s, Gb/s, B/s, kB/s, MB/s, GB/s), written as a string, e.g. "1 Gb/s". Units are case-sensitive.

bandwidth.description: Passband full width (default 0.8 × the output rate).

stopband.description: Stopband full width (default the output rate).

Duration.description: A duration with a unit (s, ms, us, µs, ns, ps), written as a string, e.g. "20.3 us". Units are case-sensitive.

Emitter.description: An RF emitter on a platform.

iq_file.description:
The recording an `iq_file` waveform plays (required exactly when
`waveform = "iq_file"`).

mount.description: The mount the emitter radiates from (default: the platform origin).

power.description: Transmit power at the antenna input.

waveform.description:
Waveform: the built-in `cw`, the built-in `iq_file` (with [`Self::iq_file`]), or
a library reference (not resolved yet).

EndPolicySpec.description: End-of-file behavior of an IQ-file emitter.

oneOf.description: The recording must cover the run: rendering past its last sample is an error.
Silence after the last sample.
The recording repeats; its last sample is followed directly by its first.

Epoch.description: UTC instant of truth time zero, as a TOML date-time with a Z (or +00:00) offset, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. Leap seconds are not accepted.

Frequency.description: A frequency with a unit (Hz, kHz, MHz, GHz), written as a string, e.g. "1090 MHz". Units are case-sensitive.

FrontEndSpec.description: Front-end gain and noise figure (receiver chain stage 1).

gain.description: Power gain from the receiver input to the ADC input.

Gain.description: A gain with a unit (dB, dBi), written as a string, e.g. "3 dBi". Units are case-sensitive.

path.description:
A GeographicLib PGM geoid grid (e.g. `egm96-5.pgm`), relative to the scenario
file unless absolute.

Ident.description: An entity name or a reference to one: ASCII letters, digits, '_' and '-'.

IqFileSpec.description:
An IQ-file emitter: a SigMF ci16_le or cf32_le recording played on the emitter's
carrier (contracts §5.6). The emitter `frequency` is the RF frequency of the file's
0 Hz, and its native rate is the recording's `core:sample_rate`.

end.description: What happens after the last sample.

normalization.description: How sample values map to the emitter `power`.

path.description:
The recording: its `.sigmf-meta` or `.sigmf-data` file, or the common stem,
relative to the scenario file unless absolute.

response.description:
The source reconstruction response (defaults: bandwidth 0.8 × and stopband 1 ×
the native rate, 80 dB).

sample_rate.description: The native rate, if stated: it must equal the recording's `core:sample_rate`.

start.description: Truth time at which sample 0 is emitted (default 0 s, not negative).

IqSpec.description: IQ imbalance and DC offset (receiver chain stage 4).

dc_i.description: DC offset on I as a fraction of the ADC full scale (default 0).

dc_q.description: DC offset on Q as a fraction of the ADC full scale (default 0).

gain_imbalance.description: Q-branch gain relative to I (default 0 dB).

Latitude.description: latitude in degrees: a number (N positive) or a string in decimal degrees or degrees-minutes-seconds with an optional N/S letter, e.g. "38°53'23.3"N".

paths.description:
Directories searched in order for library items, relative to the scenario
file unless absolute.

LibraryRef.description: A library item name, resolved on the library search path: ASCII letters, digits, '_', '-', '.' and '/'.

oneOf.description: No frequency or phase error.
A constant frequency error `offset`; phase noise is not modelled yet.

offset.description: LO frequency error for `fixed_offset` (LO minus nominal).

Longitude.description: longitude in degrees: a number (E positive) or a string in decimal degrees or degrees-minutes-seconds with an optional E/W letter, e.g. "77.0365 W".

Mgrs.description: An MGRS reference on WGS84 (zone, band, 100 km square, 0–5 digits each of easting and northing), e.g. "18SUJ2337106519". It denotes the south-west corner of the grid square. Polar (UPS) bands A, B, Y, Z are not supported.

Mount.description: An antenna mount on a platform (placeholder: lever arm and orientation come later).

NormalizationSpec.description: Level normalization of an IQ-file emitter.

oneOf.description:
`power` is the power of a full-scale sample (|x| = 1: cf32 magnitude 1, ci16
magnitude 32768).
`power` is the recording's mean power over all its samples.

Platform.description: A platform: a body with a position, trajectory and antenna mounts.

mounts.description: Antenna mounts on the platform body.

Position.description: A WGS84 position: `lat` and `lon`, or `mgrs`, plus `alt`.

alt.description: Altitude with its reference, e.g. "120 m AGL".

mgrs.description: MGRS reference (instead of lat/lon); the south-west corner of its square.

Power.description: A power with a unit (W, mW, dBm, dBW), written as a string, e.g. "30 dBm". Units are case-sensitive.

Pressure.description: A pressure with a unit (Pa, hPa, mbar, inHg), written as a string, e.g. "1013.25 hPa". Units are case-sensitive.

Receiver.description: A virtual receiver: an antenna on a platform feeding one or more channels.

mount.description: The mount the receiver antenna sits on (default: the platform origin).

platform.description: The platform carrying the receiver antenna.

block.description:
Block length (default 1 ms). It must be a whole number of samples at every
channel and antenna-port rate.

duration.description: How much truth time to render, from the epoch.

Resource.description: A shared hardware resource with an optional usable capacity (contracts §8).

capacity.description: Usable capacity, e.g. "1 Gb/s". Omitted means unknown, reported as unverified.

oneOf.description: A network interface.
A disk or storage volume.
A USB controller.
A PCIe link or root port.

ResponseDetail.description:
Details of a pre-sampling tap response (H_rx or B_out), beyond its bandwidth.

The response is a linear-phase lowpass with passband edge `bandwidth / 2` and
stopband edge `stopband / 2` around the centre (contracts §5.1).

attenuation.description: Minimum stopband attenuation (default 80 dB, 20 to 200 dB).

stopband.description:
Full width at which the stopband begins (default: the complex sample rate).
It must exceed the bandwidth and be at most the sample rate.

oneOf.description: As fast as possible; no deadlines.
Paced to the wall clock, with sink deadlines and resource budgets.

SampleFormatSpec.description: Sample formats a sink can write.

oneOf.description: Complex int16, little-endian (sc16).
Complex float32, little-endian.

SampleRate.description: A sample rate with a unit (S/s, kS/s, MS/s, GS/s), written as a string, e.g. "61.44 MS/s". Units are case-sensitive.

Sink.description: An output sink (placeholder: endpoint and file settings come with the sinks).

resources.description: Shared resources this sink's traffic crosses.

oneOf.description: SigMF recording.
Strict, acknowledged framed ZMQ stream.
VITA-49 over UDP.
Best-effort raw ZMQ PUB preview.

SourceResponseSpec.description: The source reconstruction response of an IQ-file emitter (full widths).

bandwidth.description: Passband full width (default 0.8 × the native rate).

stopband.description: Stopband full width (default the native rate, at most the native rate).

oneOf.description: The platform stays at its position.

geoid.description:
Geoid grid. Without one, the geoid height is 0 everywhere (MSL is the
ellipsoid) and the run manifest carries a warning.

pressure_offset.description:
Local sea-level pressure minus 1013.25 hPa (QNH − standard), default 0. Shifts
pressure altitude (Mode C) and the geometric height of flight levels.
